jes...@uic.edu wrote:
> Can you play political cards for votes on a bloodhunt?

Yes. Also, votes from titled vampires can be used, the Edge can
be burned for a vote, cards that can be used to gain votes (except
cards that are restricted to Political Actions) can be used -
like Ventrue Headquarters. etc. Note that action modifiers and
reactions cannot be played, since there is not action to modify
or react to.

20.2 Voting and Diablerie: The Blood Hunt
...The rules for calling this
kind of vote are the same as calling any other vote, with two exceptions:
The Methuselah calling the vote does not get one free vote (since there
isn't a card used), and the vote cannot be blocked (since calling the vote
isn't an action).
